candidates.statement: Payment service returns 503 on POST /v1/authorizations (fast, ~1ms), causing order to return 502 and gateway checkout to fail with 502. Payment logs show repeated 503s including /readyz, indicating payment is unavailable/unhealthy rather than slow.
candidates.uncertainty: Exact internal cause of payment 503 (config, dependency, crash) not established; payment metrics and order logs were excluded from context.

report.explanation: Traces show checkout 502 originates from order 502, which stems from payment returning 503 on /v1/authorizations; inventory/reservations succeed. Payment logs confirm sustained 503s including /readyz. Deployment record only shows payment v1.0.0 baseline and does not establish deployment causation. Bounded candidate: payment unavailability causing HTTP 5xx propagation.
missing_evidence: Payment service metrics (error rates, resource saturation) to determine why payment returns 503
Payment readiness/health probe failure reason and any startup or crash logs
Order service logs to confirm 502 is a pass-through of payment 503
